title: The Archive of New Lagos
author: Vesper Blackwood
blurb: Marguerite Montrose, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
